page_title: LEG 1-0 SEV | Leganes v Sevilla 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Peque (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
90+5' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
90+4' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
90+4' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Pulido blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Leganes.
90+2' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Roberto Lopez (Leganes) is brought on as a substitute for Seydouba Cisse.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Djibril Sow departs the field of play to be replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
88' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) replacing Jose Angel Carmona.
87' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
84' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
82' 1 - 0 Goal! Alvaro Fernandez gets a hand on the penalty from Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes), but can't stop it from flying into the top right corner.
82' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
81' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Juan Pulido signals a set piece. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Leganes!!
80' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!

78' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) replaces Juan Cruz.
76' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Renato Tapia and he is replaced by Julian Chicco (Leganes).
75' Juan Cruz (Leganes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jesus Navas (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch for Kelechi Iheanacho.
73' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
72' Sevilla are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
70' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
69' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
68' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
67' Enric Franquesa is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Javi Hernandez (Leganes).
65' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

64' The ball is behind the touchline and Sevilla will take a throw-in. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
62' The corner from Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence.

62' Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

61' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
61' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.

59' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
58' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic is equal to it and makes an easy save.

56' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.

53' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Alvaro Fernandez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

52' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
51' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.

50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
47' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) picks up a long through ball, but Alvaro Fernandez deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' Juan Pulido blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
44' The linesman signals that Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
41' It's a yellow card for Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes).
41' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
41' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
39' Wonderful movement by Leganes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

37' A precise low pass is received by Isaac Romero (Sevilla), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
34' Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

32' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.

30' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Pulido blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Leganes.

29' What a wasted opportunity by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Fernandez makes an astonishing save to thwart him.

27' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
26' A cross is whipped into the box by Juan Cruz (Leganes) and Miguel de la Fuente controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
24' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. It's a throw-in for Sevilla.
22' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

21' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
20' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
20' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Sevilla will have an opportunity.

19' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sevilla are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' Alvaro Fernandez blocks Munir El Haddadi (Leganes)'s effort from the edge of the box.
14' Kike Salas (Sevilla) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
14' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

13' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Sevilla will take a corner.

12' Kike Salas (Sevilla) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
12' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
11' The ball is cleared after Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
9' Juan Cruz (Leganes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Fernandez, who smothers the ball.
8' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' A long through ball into the box almost gives Isaac Romero (Sevilla) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
5' Leganes show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
4' Juan Cruz (Leganes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Juan Pulido was nominated as the referee for this game.
